title: The Lost One's Trade
text: A peddler at the roadside wears a ring with your House's crest on his little finger, too small for him, cutting into the flesh. He swears he bought it fair, from someone who needed bread. His eyes keep going to your swords.

options.label: Buy back the ring, and the story with it.

outcomes.text: He tells you where, and when. It was not long ago, and he will not meet your eyes.

options.label: The strongest asks him again, closer.

outcomes.text: He tells it fast, with a blade at his throat, and the road hears how you got it.
He whistles, and he has friends.

options.label: The shrewdest watches his face as he talks.

outcomes.text: He is lying about the bread. He is not lying about the place.
